narrative.overview:
The site reads like the technical datasheet of a component: pale engineering-green paper, near-black ink, one petrol signal colour, heavy rules between sections and a two-digit number in front of every section heading. Information is organised by lines, numbers and tables, never by floating cards, depth or atmosphere. The reader is writing YAML next to it; every visual decision serves finding a role, an option or an example fast.

Density is that of a reference sheet: a 46 rem reading measure, condensed heavy headings, monospaced labels in small caps-like tracking, and tables that carry structure the way a spec sheet does. Light is the default; dark mode inverts paper and ink and lifts the signal to a bright petrol.

Rejected on purpose, so the site does not drift back to a template look: cream paper with an orange accent (reads as the Claude brand), Vercel or Linear blue, Stripe purple, gradients, glass, large soft shadows, scroll or fade-in motion, emoji icons, card grids, hero buttons, decorative badges.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered sections: every `h2` carries `01`, `02`, … in petrol mono.
Rules, not surfaces: 3 px ink rules for structure, 1 px hairlines for detail.
One accent colour, used for links, numbers, keywords and focus only.
No motion beyond the browser's own anchor scrolling.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Petrol is the only accent. A second hue appears only as a status (ok, warn, bad) or the search marker, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Same-Ink Rule
rules.body: Rules are drawn in text ink (`rule` equals `ink`). Structure is as dark as the words it separates.

rules.name: The Lowercase Name Rule
rules.body: "arillso" is always lowercase. No `text-transform: uppercase` on anything that can contain the name (headings, navigation captions, wordmark); only fixed labels such as table heads are uppercased.

rules.name: The Width-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Heading rank is expressed through weight and width as much as size; never introduce a second display family.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it a rule or a paper tone, never a shadow, blur or gradient.

dos: **Do** take every colour from `src/styles/tokens.css`; define dark values for both the media query and `data-theme="dark"`.
**Do** separate sections with rules: 3 px `rule` for structure, 1 px `hair` for detail.
**Do** set labels, captions, numbers and code in IBM Plex Mono.
**Do** keep a visible 3 px petrol focus ring and WCAG AA contrast in both themes.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glass effects, blur or box shadows.
**Don't** add scroll, fade-in or reveal animations.
**Don't** use emoji icons, card grids, hero buttons or decorative badges.
**Don't** introduce cream paper with orange, Vercel/Linear blue or Stripe purple.
**Don't** uppercase text that can contain the name "arillso".
